install.installSection:
## Quick start

| You have | Do this |
|---|---|
| **A computer** | Use the prompt with a coding assistant: the three steps below. |
| **A computer, no coding assistant** | Run the three steps yourself: the commands are in [Doing it by hand](#doing-it-by-hand). |
| **A phone or laptop, no coding assistant** | Pick one of the [community apps](https://cleanyour.tv/app): free, open-source apps built on these TV lists by independent developers. |

The three steps below are written for a coding assistant: the computer needs to be on the same Wi-Fi as
the TV, with a shell on it, plus Python 3, a JDK from 17 through 22, and Android SDK platform 34
with build-tools 34 (the assistant builds the launcher there).
Without an assistant, [Doing it by hand](#doing-it-by-hand)
is the same job, run by you, and it has the install commands.

Any of these work: Claude Code (on [0G Private Computer](https://pc.0g.ai/?utm_source=cleanyourtv&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=readme) or an [Anthropic plan](https://claude.com/pricing)), [Codex](https://github.com/openai/codex), [Gemini CLI](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli), [Antigravity CLI](https://antigravity.google/product/antigravity-cli) or [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

| Where | What to do |
|---|---|
| **1. On the TV** | Settings → Device Preferences → About → press OK on **Build** seven times → back → Developer options → **USB debugging** on. If you see a Network or ADB debugging toggle, turn that on too. Keep the TV on. |
| **2. On your computer** | Clone the repo and open that folder in your assistant (`git clone https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv`), then paste [`PROMPT.md`](PROMPT.md) and fill in your TV model. |
| **3. Follow along** | Accept "Allow USB debugging?" on the TV, then answer the checklist: which apps you use, the dock size and app order, whether to keep the voice assistant, Chromecast and updates. |

Cloning matters: the assistant reuses this repo's `tools/disable.sh` and `launcher/build-and-install.sh`
instead of writing its own, and that is where the backup, the Home guard and the restore record live.

The assistant backs up, debloats, builds and installs the launcher, and checks each step with
screenshots pulled from the TV. With this repo as context it takes about fifteen minutes.

## 安装

> **⚠️ 不要安装 npm 上那个裸名的 `dsh-our-free-model`。**
>
> npm 上的 `dsh-our-free-model` 包**不是本仓库发布的**。它由第三方打包，内容与本仓库
> 不一致：`index.js`、`client.js` 被改动，并额外包含本仓库从未有过的
> `src/channel-visibility.js`。装到它得不到本项目审核过的构建，也拿不到本仓库的签名
> 清单校验与应用内升级。
>
> 本仓库自己发布的是带 scope 的 **`@ebony-vinyl/dsh-our-free-model`**，与 Release 的
> `dsh-our-free-model-<版本>.tgz` 同源、同版本。只想走 npm 时可以装它：
>
> ```
> dsh plugin --profile web add @ebony-vinyl/dsh-our-free-model@2.8.5
> ```
>
> 注意它的包名带 scope，因此挂载条目是 `@ebony-vinyl/dsh-our-free-model`，与下文
> 裸包名的本地安装方式不能混用（同一个 profile 里只选一种）。
>
> 其它渠道出现的同名包一律以本仓库为准。


**命令行（纯 dsh web）**

```
dsh plugin --profile web add /绝对路径/dsh-our-free-model
```

安装完成后重启应用一次。`--profile` 填写实际使用的 profile 名称。

**DSHEAC AIO / 桌面端：请先阅读本节**

部分 DSHEAC AIO / 旧版桌面整合包在启动 web 服务之前会执行 profile 闸门，
限制 profile 中的符号链接或目录 junction。若当前宿主包含该检查，可能报错：

```
PROFILE_UPGRADE_REQUIRED: offline dependency migration is not yet available
```

遇到该闸门时，不要使用 `link:` 依赖或 junction；使用应用内插件管理器，
或下方的本地 tarball 安装。不同宿主的限制以自身日志和安装机制为准。

以真实目录手工安装时，使用可信源码打出的本地 tarball：

1. 创建 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/vendor/`，在审核过的本仓库目录运行 `npm pack --ignore-scripts --pack-destination "<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/vendor"`，或将本仓库正式发布的同版本 tarball 放入该目录。本地打包不执行 npm 发布。
2. 在 profile 的 `package.json` 的 dependencies 中加入 `"dsh-our-free-model": "file:./vendor/dsh-our-free-model-2.8.5.tgz"`。文件名版本跟随仓库 `package.json`，不要改成同名 npm 注册表版本；再通过宿主的安装流程解析依赖。
3. 在 dsh.profile.bundles 末尾追加 `"dsh-our-free-model"`。

包管理器拥有这份安装的字节时，同时将 bundle config 或插件 `settings.json` 的 `distribution` 设为 `managed`，由包管理器统一更新；应用内升级、公告 feed 与热重载会停用，模型功能保留。以后更新时替换可信 tarball 并同步依赖路径，避免包管理器按旧锁文件恢复旧版本。

若手工复制发布文件，必须复制完整包，包括 `adapter/`、`src/`、`locale/`、`vendor/` 下的引擎资源目录（`engine.json`、LICENSE、NOTICE 与对应二进制），以及 `vendor/channel-pack/` 下的 `pack.js`、WASM、LICENSE、NOTICE；只复制入口脚本会导致渠道加载失败。

不要再向 cordis.patch.yml 添加条目。被 dsh.profile.bundles 引用的包，其自带的
patch 层会自动生效；两处同时注册将报错 duplicate loader entry id: our-free-model。

**整合包（托管安装）**

插件由整合包（EAC 整合包、Mojobox 等）安装时，更新时机与文件字节由安装方控制：
安装时将 bundle config 设为 distribution: 'managed'（或向 settings.json 写入
同一字段），插件的应用内升级、公告 feed 与热重载即全部停用——两个写入方同时操作
同一安装目录只会导致目录损坏；模型 lane 不受影响。相关验收见
scripts/offline-test.mjs；目录就绪记录（manifest 0.15 / 出处 / 许可 / 完整性）
位于 catalog/ 下。

**启动桌面端前的自检**

可直接调用桌面端自身的闸门代码进行自检：

```
node -e "
const g = require('/sidecar/dist/lib/profile-upgrade.js');
const app = '', profile = '/profiles/';
console.log(g.planProfileUpgrade(app, profile));
g.assertProfileStartup(app, profile);
console.log('startup gate: PASS');
"
```

预期输出为 status

## 安装

安装要求为 Android 8.0（API 26）及以上。Release 页面上的 **arm64** 安装包适用于常见的 64 位 Android 手机；x86_64 设备和模拟器用的 x64 包在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。仓库没有 32 位 ARM 构建。

1. 从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/latest) 或[官网下载页](https://go.dshtui.com/download)下载对应架构的 APK，并按系统提示允许该安装来源。
2. 首次启动时，选择在本机安装运行环境，或连接远程主机。
3. 为所选主机配置模型和所需凭据，再开始对话；部分远程渠道需要在主机侧配置。

仅连接远程主机时，不必在手机上安装本机运行环境。手机操控只对正常模式下的本机引擎开放，需要按界面说明开启无障碍等权限；不打扰模式另外要求 Android 14 及以上，以及 Shizuku 或自连 ADB。首次使用可按[使用指南](docs/guide/README.md)逐项配置。

本地引擎默认使用 PRoot 兼容启动。开发者选项中的直接启动默认关闭，开启后的兼容性和回退方式见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。当前 Android 构建以 APK 侧载为目标，不是 Google Play 发布配置。

install.installSection:
## Install

For Claude Code, install it as a plugin. Run this in a terminal to get it in every project:

```bash
claude plugin install unslop --marketplace heydamir/unslop
```

On an older Claude Code without `--marketplace`, the same in two steps:

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add heydamir/unslop
claude plugin install unslop@heydamir
```

To get it in a single project only, run the install from that project's root folder, the one you start Claude Code in, and add `--scope local`. To turn it on for everyone who works in the project, add `--scope project` instead and commit `.claude/settings.json`. Each teammate then runs this once in their own copy of the project:

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add heydamir/unslop
claude plugin install unslop@heydamir --scope project
```

Then start a new Claude Code session, or run `/reload-plugins` in one that is already open.

To update, run `claude plugin update unslop@heydamir`, or turn on auto-update for the heydamir marketplace under Marketplaces in `/plugin`.

If you copied unslop into `~/.claude/skills/` or a project's `.claude/skills/` before, delete that copy, or `/unslop` keeps running it instead of the plugin.

For Codex, ask it to install the skill straight from this repo.

```
$skill-installer install https://github.com/heydamir/unslop/tree/main/skills/unslop
```

Or copy it by hand into `~/.agents/skills/`, or into `.agents/skills/` inside a single project.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/heydamir/unslop
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && cp -r unslop/skills/unslop ~/.agents/skills/
```

For Google Antigravity, copy the skill into your skills folder.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/heydamir/unslop
mkdir -p ~/.gemini/config/skills && cp -r unslop/skills/unslop ~/.gemini/config/skills/
```

For a single project, copy it into `.agents/skills/` inside that project instead.

To snapshot a live site or create a story video, install Playwright and its Chromium browser from the project directory where you run the skill:

```bash
npm install -D playwright
npx playwright install chromium
```

Story videos also require ffmpeg installed and available on your PATH.
